python3 -c "
from PIL import Image
im = Image.open('real_mobile_full.png')
w,h = im.size
print(w,h)
n = 4
step = h // n
for i in range(n):
    top = i*step
    bottom = h if i==n-1 else (i+1)*step
    im.crop((0, top, w, bottom)).save(f'mobile_part{i+1}.png')
" 2>&1
